in_marathi.name: Parshuram
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Rama with axe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parshuram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Parshurama, the sixth avatar of Lord Vishnu, was born to rid the earth of the Kshatriyas who had forgotten their duty as protectors of the people. He wielded an axe and was invincible in battle.

in_bengali.name: Parshuram

in_bengali.long_meaning: Parshuram একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Parshurama, the sixth avatar of Lord Vishnu, was born to rid the earth of the Kshatriyas who had forgotten their duty as protectors of the people. He wielded an axe and was invincible in battle.
